taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bank-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 640 | 5.21 | 5.21
2 | 934 | 8.58 | 13.8
3 | 2594 | 84.1 | 97.9
4 | 4386 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bank-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AK-type (as logged on file) — note: the resistivity sequence (640 → 934 → 2594 → 4386 Ω·m) is monotonically increasing, which is actually characteristic of an A-type curve; the AK classification should be re-checked against the raw field curve before finalizing the report.
Aquifer depth: 13.8 – 97.9 m (Layer 3, 2594 Ω·m, underlain by a much more resistive basal unit of 4386 Ω·m interpreted as bedrock/consolidated formation)
Recommendation: Target drilling within the 13.8–97.9 m interval, which represents the most probable water-bearing zone above the resistive basement; confirm curve-type classification with the original field data before finalizing aquifer thickness estimates.
